captions.detailed: A cylindrical adapter sleeve featuring a hollow core running through its entire length. The main body is a tall, slightly tapered cylinder with a thin, flat flange protruding outwards at the bottom base. Both the top rim and the inner bottom edge are smoothly rounded with circular profiles to prevent sharp edges and facilitate hose or pipe insertion.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric cylindrical adapter in OpenSCAD with a hollow core and a flat bottom flange. The user should be able to adjust the inner diameter, bottom outer diameter, top outer diameter, flange diameter, flange thickness, and overall cylinder height, with rounded rings at both ends for smooth transitions.
captions.factory: The script defines a parametric adapter using a union of a main hollowed cylinder and two rounded rings. The main body combines a main cylinder (using cylinder with r1 and r2) and a bottom flange cylinder, which are hollowed out using difference with two inner cylinders of differing diameters. The top and bottom rims are rounded using rotate_extrude and translate on a 2D circle primitive to form tori at the boundaries.
